description:
Join the Board of a growing £1m charity that serves 11,500 students. We're recruiting a Finance Trustee and an HR Trustee to help deliver our five-year strategy, with early-evening meetings and no previous board experience needed.

Roehampton Students' Union (RSU) is here to make student life better at Roehampton, and we're an organisation with real momentum. We've just grown past £1 million in turnover, and our National Student Survey score has risen three years in a row. In 2025 we launched Foundations for the Future, our five-year strategy through to 2030. Now we're looking for two senior professionals to help us build on that success.

As a Lay Trustee, you'll bring an outside perspective that no student or staff member can. You'll sit alongside elected student officers to set strategy, scrutinise decisions and hold the organisation to account. You'll share full legal responsibility as a trustee and Company Director. This is an active role for someone who asks good questions.

Finance Trustee
You'll help keep RSU financially sound and sustainable as we grow. That means shaping our finance, fundraising and reserves strategies, and scrutinising performance against commercial and fundraising targets. You'll make sure the Board has real oversight of how resources are used, working closely with the Chief Executive and senior staff team.

HR Trustee
You'll help make RSU a healthy, high-performing place to work. That means contributing to workforce strategy, including pay, wellbeing and staff development, and making sure the Board has proper oversight of HR policy and equality, diversity and inclusion practice. You'll work closely with the Chief Executive and senior leadership team on culture and people.

Who we're looking for
You'll need senior-level professional expertise in finance, or in HR and people management. You don't need previous board experience, because we'll support you to become an effective trustee. We're looking for people who:
- Challenge constructively, and act as a critical friend
- Think strategically and weigh competing priorities
- Care about students and are curious about Higher Education and students' unions
- Enjoy supporting and mentoring others, including young student leaders
- Are committed to good governance, safeguarding, and equity, diversity and inclusion
